# Isaiah Chapter 55 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 13 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Come to the waters; seek the LORD; word shall not return empty; mountains and hills sing; peace*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Invitation to the Thirsty:** Come to the waters; seek the LORD; word shall not return empty; mountains and hills sing; peace. The key message for modern readers: "My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, declares the LORD"

*-- PNEUMA*
